character: Short, modern German circuit built after the historic forest layout was truncated in 2002. A long straight into a tight hairpin (Spitzkehre) leads into the Motodrom stadium section, where several corners are packed in front of the grandstands.
sources: long-established F1/DTM circuit knowledge (Wikipedia, racingcircuits.info) — Spitzkehre/Sachskurve/Motodrom naming well documented since the 2002 circuit shortening

corners.name: Nordkurve
corners.type: medium-speed right-hander off the front straight (Turn 1)
corners.trap: Running wide compromises the run to the following section

corners.name: Turn 6
corners.type: fast right-hander leading onto the back straight
corners.technique: Commit with smooth steering, carry speed onto the straight
corners.trap: Lifting unnecessarily costs speed down the entire straight

corners.name: Spitzkehre
corners.type: very tight hairpin at the end of the long back straight
corners.technique: Hard, late braking from very high speed, patient throttle on exit
corners.trap: Locking the front from the high approach speed

corners.name: Sachskurve
corners.type: fast corner leading into the Motodrom stadium section
corners.technique: Commit through the corner, smooth transition into the technical stadium sequence
corners.trap: Over-driving the entry and compromising the stadium section that follows

corners.name: Motodrom
corners.type: tight, technical stadium section in front of the grandstands (final corners)
corners.technique: Patient, precise inputs through the tightening sequence, clean exit onto the front straight is critical
corners.trap: Compromised exit here costs time down the entire front straight
